physicalNotes: Radius 0.949 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Georgieva et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-733 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract): 660,219 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 5585 +/- 60 K from Georgieva et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-733 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...674A.117G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
